lines: You start every day digging through sixty emails. Deals die because the updates live in your head.
Meet Jordyn. A custom-trained AI employee that works your email, phone, and paperwork from day one. Real digital staff, not another chatbot.
Tell her your industry. Her brain installs in seconds. The vocabulary, the workflows, the paperwork, the unwritten rules. She arrives speaking your language.
Every inbox swept overnight. What needs you is waiting before your coffee.
Replies drafted in your voice. Every one stays a draft until you hit send. Ever.
She answers your phone in your business's name, and callers book real appointments mid-call. Eighteen cents a minute. No plans, no seats.
Deals, decisions, and to-dos record themselves from your email. Your CRM builds itself.
Say invoice Chen twelve hundred. A branded invoice, a pay-online link, chased until it's paid.
Letters, PDFs, and presentations on your letterhead. Edit a sent deck. Same link, new version.
The tool stack, five eighty-five a month. A human assistant, three thousand plus. Jordyn, four ninety-nine. And she does the work.
Hire your first digital employee. Jordyn dot app.
